Class FormulaParser

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static Formula parse(String expression) throws FormulaParser.SyntaxException
      Parses a CTL formula with Boolean operator precedence and temporal modalities. Supported operators include not, and, or, -&gt;, EX, AX, EF, AF, EG, AG, E(... U ...), and A(... U ...).
      Parameters:
      expression - user-entered formula text
      Returns:
      the parsed expression tree
      Throws:
      FormulaParser.SyntaxException - if the formula is not well formed
